## Key Data Engineering Projects & Case Studies

1. [Databricks Fraud Detection Pipeline](https://yassser0.github.io/MohammedYasserRachih/projects/databricks-fraud-detection.html)
   - Enterprise Lakehouse platform implementing Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) on Databricks with ACID compliance on Delta Lake.
   - High-throughput transactional data ingestion, deduplication, anomaly and fraud scoring rules in Silver, and aggregated business risk data marts in Gold.
   - Centralized governance with Unity Catalog and query acceleration with Z-Ordering.

2. [Data Quality & Observability Platform](https://yassser0.github.io/MohammedYasserRachih/projects/data-quality-observability.html)
   - End-to-end automated ETL data pipeline extracting multi-source datasets (REST APIs, CSV files).
   - Orchestrated with idempotent Apache Airflow DAGs, transformed and quality-tested using dbt models.
   - Automated retry handling, schema integrity assertions, and Slack alert notifications loaded into Snowflake and PostgreSQL.

3. [Morocco DataHub](https://yassser0.github.io/MohammedYasserRachih/projects/morocco-datahub.html)
   - DataTech project centralizing and standardizing Moroccan public open datasets (HCP, data.gov.ma, Bank Al-Maghrib).
   - Automated Python ETL ingestion, PostgreSQL structured storage, and high-performance REST APIs powered by FastAPI with OpenAPI / Swagger documentation.

4. [Smart Port Operations — Marsa Maroc](https://yassser0.github.io/MohammedYasserRachih/projects/smart-port-operations-marsa-maroc.html)
   - Data engineering and platform development internship at Marsa Maroc (Casablanca port operations, March – July 2026).
   - Development of data collection pipelines, data reliability checks, monitoring of processing jobs, and operations tracking.
